_about: Inputs to metrology/error_budget.py. Every number carries its source. 'assumed' means nobody has measured it yet: when you measure it, replace the value and change the source to say how and when.

approach.source: assumed: firmware doesn't yet approach every target from the same side

unidirectional_residual_frac.source: assumed: share of a direction-dependent error left after one-sided approach plus calibration

full_steps_per_rev.source: 1.8 deg NEMA 17 (hardware doc). pcb_robot_workspace/config.yaml says 'steps: 400', so confirm the motor

gear_ratio.source: hardware doc: the arm connector locks onto the motor shaft (direct drive)

step_accuracy_pct.source: typical hybrid-stepper datasheet: +/-5% of a full step, no load

holding_torque_nm.source: assumed typical 40 mm NEMA 17: read your motor's datasheet

hold_current_frac.source: hardware doc: hold current at 50-60% of run current

load_torque_nm.source: assumed: vacuum hose and wiring drag plus bearing friction. Measure it

backlash_deg.source: assumed with the spring anti-backlash nuts; the hardware doc's figure without them is 0.3 deg

zero_uncertainty_deg.source: assumed: where the joint really is at commanded zero, before calibration

homing_repeatability_deg.source: assumed limit switch; not used when an absolute encoder sets zero

present.source: hardware doc: AS5048A on the base and shoulder shafts

location.source: hardware doc: mounted on the motor shaft

inl_deg.source: AS5048A datasheet: INL +/-0.8 deg at optimum magnet placement, 25 C

linearized_residual_deg.source: AS5048A datasheet: 0.05 deg system accuracy, only with linearization and averaging in the MCU

full_steps_per_rev.source: assumed 1.8 deg NEMA 14 (hardware doc names NEMA 14, not its step angle)

gear_ratio.source: hardware doc: NEMA 14 bolted into the elbow connector drives the forearm directly

step_accuracy_pct.source: typical hybrid-stepper datasheet: +/-5% of a full step, no load

holding_torque_nm.source: assumed typical NEMA 14: read your motor's datasheet

hold_current_frac.source: hardware doc: hold current at 50-60% of run current

load_torque_nm.source: assumed: hose drag at the wrist. Measure it

backlash_deg.source: assumed with the spring anti-backlash nuts; the hardware doc's figure without them is 0.3 deg

zero_uncertainty_deg.source: assumed: where the joint really is at commanded zero, before calibration

homing_repeatability_deg.source: assumed limit switch at the elbow

present.source: hardware doc: the two AS5048A go on base and shoulder, not the elbow

location.source: hardware doc: mounted on the motor shaft

bits.source: AS5048A datasheet, if one is added

inl_deg.source: AS5048A datasheet: INL +/-0.8 deg at optimum magnet placement, 25 C

linearized_residual_deg.source: AS5048A datasheet: 0.05 deg system accuracy, only with linearization and averaging in the MCU

length_tolerance_mm.source: assumed: tube cut length plus printed socket depth

lateral_load_n.source: assumed: hose side load at the wrist

tube_outer_mm.source: hardware doc: 10 mm square carbon tube

tube_modulus_gpa.source: assumed, conservative for pultruded carbon tube

printed_joint_compliance_mm.source: assumed tip deflection from the PETG joints under the same load

printed_length_mm.source: assumed total PETG length in the chain

temperature_swing_k.source: assumed: room drift plus motor heating

base_offset_uncertainty_mm.source: assumed: the (190, 40) placeholder has never been measured

px_per_mm.source: assumed: 720p camera (hardware doc) seeing a 100 mm wide field

distortion_edge_pct.source: assumed for a low-cost USB lens; ChArUco calibration measures it

reprojection_rms_px.source: assumed after calibration; metrology/charuco_calib.py reports the real value

plane_offset_mm.source: standard 1.6 mm PCB: board top vs the bed the homography was taken on

plane_offset_after_mm.source: assumed 10% board-thickness tolerance once the plane is matched

px_per_mm.source: assumed close-up of the part on the nozzle

scale_error_pct.source: assumed before the bottom camera's mm/px is calibrated

pick_offset_mm.source: assumed typical part offset on the nozzle after a pick

nozzle_center_uncertainty_mm.source: assumed: nozzle axis position in the bottom image before nozzle-tip calibration

runout_tir_mm.source: assumed: NEMA 8 hollow shaft plus Juki holder. Measure it

release_slip_mm.source: assumed: part shift when vacuum releases

settle_amplitude_mm.source: assumed residual vibration after the 150 ms settle (hardware doc)

accuracy_rms_mm.source: hardware_plan_v3 section 9: positional accuracy < 0.15 mm RMS

repeatability_std_mm.source: hardware_plan_v3 section 9: repeatability < 0.1 mm std deviation

tip_measurement_sigma_mm.source: assumed: top camera reading a target on the nozzle after ChArUco calibration
